How British Grand Prix connects

  • Location: Silverstone — The British Grand Prix is run at Silverstone.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — The 1950 British Grand Prix at Silverstone opened the World Championship.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — The British Grand Prix is the championship's founding race.
  • Character: Lewis Hamilton — Hamilton's home grand prix is the British Grand Prix at Silverstone.

What is British Grand Prix?

The British Grand Prix at Silverstone was the first round of the 1950 World Championship and remains Lewis Hamilton's home crowd.
